headline: Sharp blade found in school tiffin bread in Barishal
summary: A sharp razor blade was discovered inside a bun provided as a school tiffin, prompting the formation of a probe committee to investigate the incident.
details: A sharp razor blade was discovered inside a bun provided as a school tiffin in Barishal.
The discovery was made when the bread was opened for consumption, revealing the metal object embedded within the dough.
School authorities have reacted to the incident by forming a probe committee to investigate how the blade ended up in the food.
The incident has raised concerns over the food safety and quality control of the tiffin provided to students.
caption:
A razor blade in a student's tiffin? This shocking discovery in Barishal has sparked an immediate investigation.

A sharp razor blade was discovered inside a bun provided as a school tiffin in Barishal.

The discovery was made when the bread was opened for consumption, revealing the metal object embedded within the dough.

School authorities have reacted to the incident by forming a probe committee to investigate how the blade ended up in the food.

The incident has raised concerns over the food safety and quality control of the tiffin provided to students.

headline: Farmgate 'Tip' Scandal: Constable Nazmul fired from service
summary: The police officer involved in the widely discussed 'tip' incident at Farmgate has been dismissed from his job.
details: Constable Nazmul, the officer involved in the controversial 'tip' incident at Farmgate, has been dismissed from his service.
The incident gained significant attention and public outcry after details of the officer's behavior emerged.
The police department has taken disciplinary action following an investigation into the matter.
The move comes as part of a broader effort to ensure accountability within the police force.
caption:
